sum: Cantor Equity Partners VII, Inc. focuses on effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was formerly known as CF International Acquisition Corp. IX and changed its name to Cantor Equity Partners VII, Inc. in August 2025. Cantor Equity Partners VII, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
